versions.changelog: Two proportional half-scale cards per row on phones up to 700px, with zoom-aware drag positioning. Timelines and details remain full-width. Desktop layout and accounting unchanged.
Continuous chart and value transitions, stable card surfaces, reduced-motion support, and optional merchant display names. Calculation engine unchanged.
Add filtered transaction details, area/bar trends, date picker, per-view card layouts and compact disclosures. Clarify ambiguous transactions before final charts. Accounting engine unchanged.
Chart controls and concurrent preview serving from 1.2.0, packaged as exactly 12 source files without Python caches.
Restore the circular report template: dark theme, three-column spending rings, merchant breakdowns, original view hierarchy and bilingual controls.
Initial release: bilingual local finance reports, in-memory processing, explicit local export and fictional demos.
